basic_details.short_information: ONGC CA CMA Industrial Trainee Recruitment 2026: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC) has invited applications for 50 Industrial Trainee vacancies, comprising 25 CA and 25 CMA training opportunities in Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Vadodara and Kolkata. Candidates who have passed CA/CMA Intermediate, secured at least 60% overall marks in Class 12 and were born on or after 1 January 2000 can apply. The monthly stipend ranges from Rs. 22,000 to Rs. 27,000, depending on the training location and year. Eligible candidates must submit the prescribed Google Form with supporting documents by 15 N

age_limit.details: Candidates should use the date of birth recorded in their Class 10 marksheet or certificate while completing the application.

qualification.details: Applicants must have passed the relevant CA or CMA Intermediate examination, secured at least 60% overall marks in Class 12 and been born on or after 1 January 2000. | Candidates must satisfy all three conditions. Passing CA/CMA Intermediate alone is insufficient if the Class 12 percentage or date-of-birth requirement is not met.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 22,000 to Rs. 27,000, depending on the training location and applicable training year. | Important: The stipend table specifies Year 1 and Year 2 rates. However, the CA training duration is 9-12 months and CMA training duration is 15-18 months. Candidates should not assume that every trainee will complete two full years or receive the Year 2 stipend. | Leave will be governed by the respective ICAI or ICMAI rules and regulations. Selected trainees must make their own arrangements for boarding, lodging and travelling.

how_to_apply: Read the official ONGC Industrial Trainee advertisement numbered ONGC/Industrial Trainee/1/2026.
Open the official application Google Form at forms.gle/zpmfeDo9E3MGn2E19.
Enter the details requested in the application form accurately.
Provide the relevant CA or CMA Intermediate examination details, including Group 1 and Group 2 results.
Upload a recent photograph in JPG format.
Upload the Class 10 certificate or marksheet as date-of-birth proof, Aadhaar card and Class 12 marksheet in PDF format.
Upload the required CA/CMA Intermediate marksheets for both groups as separate PDF files, including failed attempts.
Upload caste, disability or ONGC employee-related supporting documents wherever applicable.
Ensure the uploaded documents are self-attested and named according to the prescribed instructions.
Review all information and submit the Google Form by 15 November 2026.

Important: The official notice requires separate PDF files for CA/CMA Intermediate Group 1 and Group 2 marksheets, including unsuccessful attempts. Candidates should not upload only their final passing marksheets if earlier attempts are also applicable.
important_instructions: Applicants must have passed CA or CMA Intermediate and secured at least 60% overall in Class 12. Candidates must have been born on or after 1 January 2000. The application must be submitted through the prescribed Google Form by 15 November 2026. Both CA/CMA Intermediate group marksheets, including failed attempts, must be uploaded separately. Preference will be given to ONGC wards and candidates who passed the examination on their first attempt. Interview may be conducted online, offline or telephonically. Candidates must bear their own interview expenses. Selected trainees must arrange their own accommodation, boarding and travel. ONGC reserves the right to make the final selection.

content_sections.heading: ONGC CA CMA Industrial Trainee Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must have passed the relevant CA or CMA Intermediate examination, secured at least 60% overall marks in Class 12 and been born on or after 1 January 2000. Candidates must satisfy all three conditions. Passing CA/CMA Intermediate alone is insufficient if the Class 12 percentage or date-of-birth requirement is not met.

content_sections.text: The training period differs for CA and CMA candidates.

content_sections.heading: ONGC CA CMA Industrial Trainee Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 22,000 to Rs. 27,000 , depending on the training location and applicable training year. Important: The stipend table specifies Year 1 and Year 2 rates. However, the CA training duration is 9-12 months and CMA training duration is 15-18 months. Candidates should not assume that every trainee will complete two full years or receive the Year 2 stipend. Leave will be governed by the respective ICAI or ICMAI rules and regulations. Selected trainees must make their own arrangements for boarding, lodging and travelling.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ONGC CA CMA Industrial Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: ONGC has provided document-specific file formats and naming instructions. Applicants should prepare the following documents before opening the application form. ONGC requires document filenames to begin with the candidate's full name as recorded in the Class 10 certificate, followed by the relevant document suffix. For example, a candidate whose full name in the Class 10 certificate is "abcdef" would use filenames such as: abcdef_Photo.jpg abcdef_DOB.pdf abcdef_ID.pdf abcdef_Marksheet Group 1.pdf abcdef_Marksheet Group 2.pdf Applicants claiming the ONGC employee category must upload the relevant parent's or relative's ONGC Employee ID and provide the employee CPF number in the appropriate field of the Google Form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ONGC CA CMA Industrial Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ONGC has announced 50 industrial training opportunities, comprising 25 CA and 25 CMA seats.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ONGC CA CMA Industrial Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application through the prescribed Google Form is 15 November 2026, according to the official advertisement dated 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for ONGC CA CMA Industrial Training 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates who have passed CA or CMA Intermediate, secured at least 60% overall marks in Class 12 and were born on or after 1 January 2000 can apply

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly stipend for ONGC CA CMA Industrial Trainees?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 25,000 in Year 1 and Rs. 27,000 in Year 2 for Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. For Vadodara, the stipend is Rs. 22,000 in Year 1 and Rs. 25,000 in Year 2, subject to the applicable training duration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the training duration for ONGC CA and CMA Industrial Trainees?
faq.answer: The detailed notification specifies 9 to 12 months for CA candidates and 15 to 18 months for CMA candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a written examination for ONGC CA CMA Industrial Trainee selection?
faq.answer: The advertisement does not prescribe a separate written examination. Selection is based on essential eligibility criteria and the stated preference conditions, with interview arrangements provided by ONGC.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates who passed CA/CMA Intermediate after multiple attempts apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification requires candidates to have passed the relevant Intermediate examination and gives preference to first-attempt pass candidates. It also requires marksheets covering failed attempts to be uploaded.

faq.question: Q8. Is ONGC CA CMA Industrial Training a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The advertisement offers industrial training opportunities for eligible CA/CMA Intermediate pass-outs and does not advertise regular permanent employment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection is based on academic eligibility, with preference given to ONGC wards and first-attempt pass candidates, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of ONGC?
faq.answer: You can visit the official ONGC website at https://www.ongcindia.com to access the notification details, updates, and application links.
